Unit 6 is located in a meticulously restored 6 unit Victorian building on Broderick between Turk and Golden Gate. The entire building has been completely rebuilt from the studs up with new high end kitchens and bathrooms alongside modern appliances, fixtures and finishes.
Unit 6 is a new ground floor unit with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, large gourmet kitchen, spacious living room and dining room, separate entrance and new oak flooring throughout. The master bedroom has large east facing windows, full bathroom and a large walk in closet . The second bedroom also has has large east facing windows and ample closet space. Bedroom 3 sits quietly in the back of the unit with ample closet space. This space would be perfect for a home office, work out room or play room.
This unit has a brand new gourmet kitchen with new stainless steel, energy efficient, appliances (refridgerator/freezer, stove, dishwasher), Caeserstone countertops, ample cabinets, large pantry and new oak flooring. The modern bathrooms are brand new with Haisa stone flooring, bathtub, sleek Grohe fixtures and modern cabinets.
Located on a quiet street but only one block away from the Divisadero Corridor featuring Nopa/Nopalito restaurants, Bi-Rite Market, Falletti Foods, Pete's Coffee, Bar Crudo, The Independent,  Little Star Pizza and much more. Close to the Muni lines: 5 Fulton, 24 Divisadero and 38 Geary. Get to CalTrain in under 15 minutes.
Walking distance to Kaiser and Mount Zion,  and a short distance from UCSF. Walk the kids to school: several options are close including San Francisco Day School and Creative Arts Charter School.
